headline: Requests to use the Salem Common Gazebo for Renfaire, a Pride parade and festival, and three weddings in 2027.
summary: Several of the gazebo events ask for amplified sound during set hours. The agenda also includes a vote for a Park and Recreation Commission member to serve a 3 year term on the Community Preservation Committee.
items: Kelly Weissinger, Salem Renfaire, Salem Common Gazebo, May 29 & 30, 2027, amplification 11:00am-6:30pm
Hope Watt-Bucci, North Shore Pride, Inc., Salem Common Gazebo, June 26, 2027, annual Pride Parade and Festival
Brooke Samora, wedding ceremony, Salem Common Gazebo, August 21, 2027, amplification 4:15pm-5:15pm
Lydia Fisher, wedding ceremony, Salem Common Gazebo, July 2, 2027, amplification 4:30pm-5:30pm
Timothy Curley, wedding ceremony, Salem Common Gazebo, June 5, 2027, amplification 4:00pm-5:00pm
Vote for Community Preservation Committee, 3 year term, Park and Recreation Commission member
